## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A ten-fascicle (10卷) full lemma-by-lemma commentary on the *Śūraṃgamasūtra* ([KR6j0118](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0118)) by **Hānshān Déqīng** 憨山德清 [德清](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%B7%E6%B8%85) (1546–1623) — the third part of his three-volume *Lèngyán* corpus, completing the prefatory *Xuánjìng* ([KR6j0685](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0685)) and *Tōngyì lüèkē* ([KR6j0686](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0686)). Preserved as **X12 no. 279** in the *Xùzàngjīng*. The work is the most influential late-Míng commentary on the *Lèngyán* alongside [真鑑](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9C%9F%E9%91%91)'s *Zhèngmài shū* ([KR6j0683](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0683)); together with *Zhèngmài shū* it defines the two principal late-Míng reform readings of the sūtra.

**Abstract**

The *Tōngyì* presents Hānshān's **mature Wànlì–era reading** of the *Lèngyánsūtra*: a syncretic Chán-Pure-Land–Huáyán-influenced reading that explicitly engages with the Tiānrú Wéizé *Huìjiě* tradition (the dominant late-Yuán to mid-Míng synthesis) and with the **emerging *Zhèngmài shū* tradition** of [真鑑](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9C%9F%E9%91%91). Hānshān's distinctive contribution is to recover the **practical-meditative dimension** of the sūtra — particularly the *ěrgēn yuántōng* 耳根圓通 doctrine and the *xiūxīn sānguān* 修心三觀 — for monastic-and-lay practical Buddhism, rather than pursuing the polemical-doctrinal contestation that animates the *Zhèngmài shū*. The preface explicitly positions the *Tōngyì* against both the *huìjiě* tradition and the recent *zībái* (monk-and-laity) profusion of partial commentaries.

The dating bracket is set to **1597 – 1623**, the productive period of Hānshān's *Lèngyán* labors from the *Xuánjìng* preface (1597) to his death.
